display_long_description:
Club Aloha VR is a real live music venue where Maui-based musicians perform for you live in their full human form. They can see, hear, and talk with you in real time. Like really real time.

Our early adopters call it “the best live music experience in VR.”

Launch into a virtual nightclub where real musicians perform live from a dedicated custom studio designed to create a conventional stage experience while seamlessly presenting the virtual audience to the artists. They feel like you are there in the studio — and you will feel it too. The result is an authentic night out with friends, music, and conversation.

Every show is performed live from Maui, Hawaii featuring talented local musicians playing pop, rock, reggae, country, folk, and island-inspired favorites. No pre-recorded videos. No AI performers. Just real musicians sharing live performances with their audience in VR.

Unlike traditional livestreams, Club Aloha VR creates genuine social presence. Dance and cheer for the band, talk with other fans, clap your hands, request songs, and torch up your lighter for encores while experiencing the energy of a real venue from anywhere in the world.

Features:
• Live interactive concerts in real time
• Full-fidelity stereo audio from the PA system
• Social VR with live audience interaction
• Interactive crowd participation
• A welcoming community of music fans and musicians

Discover why our growing community keeps coming back for the most personal live music experience in VR.
